name: Fashion Junction
description:
Fashion Junction – Affordable Branded Export Surplus & Trendy Street Fashion

Fashion Junction is a hub for high-quality, affordable branded export surplus garments and trendy street fashion designed for youth. With a three-floor retail space, we bring you a broad selection of premium surplus garments from leading international brands, all at exceptional prices. Whether you're looking for top-quality branded apparel or the latest in streetwear styles, Fashion Junction has options to suit every taste and budget.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ease of access:

[ ] Navigation accuracy - Location is correct and navigation was accurate.

[ ] Route preference - Some routes recommended might be narrow. The place is reachable easily from the main road and maps would reroute.

[ ] Wheelchair accessibility - The place is wheelchair accessible.

[ ] Parking space - 2 wheeler space available, not sure for 4 wheelers.

Experience:
[ ] Space - This is a standalone building and has 2 floors, ground floor for women and first floor for men. There is decent amount of space available. Only complaint is that it needs more trial rooms. There was a long line at all the trial rooms.

[ ] Ambience - The lighting is decent and product placement is strategic. However, the item arrangement was not cohesive in most of the places and we had to search a lot. Ex, denims in the sweater section.

[ ] Crowd - This place is slightly overcrowded, but not too uncomfortable. The place is either under-staffed or the staff is not able to manage the crowd effectively enough.

[ ] Product pricing and quality - All products are priced competitively and this is the major point of this brand. Most items are available under Rs 1.2k per piece and the quality is good for the price.

[ ] Verdict - Highly recommended for quarterly shopping.
